allowed_use_summary: WLASL is approved only for this noncommercial school assignment as local academic/computational raw-RGB training and validation data. Raw videos, modified videos, extracted frames, local mirrors, and substantial dataset excerpts must not be redistributed. No WLASL pretrained weights, pose/keypoint outputs, bounding-box crops, or feature artifacts may enter the ASL Pilot recognition path.

limitations: This is an engineering source-rights/provenance review, not legal advice.
The approval is limited to the user's clarified noncommercial school assignment.
Do not use this source for commercial, revenue-generating, or public product training.
Do not redistribute raw videos, modified videos, extracted frames, or local dataset mirrors.
Only raw source videos may be decoded; WLASL pretrained weights, keypoints, bounding boxes, feature caches, and crops are disallowed as recognition inputs.
